officialSources.observation: Official PALARIS office page identifies it as Palau’s national geospatial office/data hub and links the ArcGIS Experience.

Public ArcGIS Experience shell returned HTTP 200. Its public ArcGIS item data (item 206e4c1eb0f849c9b8aa21f967edf802, title “PALARIS Website”) lists six web-map data sources. The interactive map (item 4f6e0d33c8ad47b4aa221ddda2d490a6) publishes roads, buildings, state-boundary estimates and other infrastructure/environment layers; no cadastral or parcel layer is configured.

Public published Experience Builder configuration, HTTP 200, 412,411 bytes; web-map IDs and names recorded in the report. Public PalauGIS ArcGIS catalog search for parcel returned 0 items; cadastral returned the state-boundary feature service, not parcels.

requests.outcome: Official PALARIS GIS office page inspected and ArcGIS Experience link followed.
ArcGIS Experience shell loaded, but exposed page has no layer listing or direct query result.
Public ArcGIS item metadata returned title PALARIS Website, owner Didip73, type Web Experience.

Public app config returned 412411 bytes and six webmap data-source entries: a9b2b05410134baea7616cb2f30dbf19, 4f6e0d33c8ad47b4aa221ddda2d490a6, b8c3f90938c04926af70860128068818, bb4dc127a6944c9bb2557ee82943ce81, 2a42154a2fea42c9aaed514c902d8c6c, fbf6436b724646c28a462bc83336750d.

Published PALARIS interactive web map inspected. Feature layers include Palau_Buildings_2019, Palau_RoadNetwork_2025, Palau_StateBoundaryEstimate_2008 and other non-cadastral infrastructure/land-cover/hazard data; no parcel layer was found.
Public PalauGIS organization catalog returned total=0 for parcel.
Bounded Ngerulmud-area query returned 5 polygon building features with exceededTransferLimit=true. This is a deliberately limited building-footprint query, not cadastral evidence.

registryBasis: No parcel layer appears in the public PALARIS Experience web maps or PalauGIS parcel-name catalog results. A bounded Ngerulmud-area query to the published building layer returned polygon footprints only; no parcel/cadastre query was available from the traced app sources.
